title: ixeris humifusa
intro: Ixeris humifusa, commonly known as the creeping saxifrage or Korean licorice root, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Compositae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ixeris humifusa include its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
